### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- ListFindingAggregations VM_INSTANCE, CONTAINER_IMAGE and SERVERLESS_FUNCTION, the cloud* facets of the image-layer/coverage filters, and CoverageFilterCriteria's cloud* facets are multi-cloud (Azure) surfaces; no Azure resources exist to aggregate or cover.
- ListConnectors accounts/connectorType facets (no Connector field to match), Connector PENDING_DELETION, ScopeConfiguration ACTIVE/ERROR/DISABLED and CreateCodeSecurityIntegration authorizationUrl depend on an external Azure/OAuth consent flow no API call drives.
- GetClustersForImage reports ECS clusters only: EKS pods are not run, so there are no EKS workloads to join an image against.
- GetCisScanReport renders no PDF/CSV document, so url is always empty and TargetAccounts has nothing to scope (ReportFormat is validated).

### Deferred

- "Full CIS session lifecycle semantics (health/telemetry payload validation, session expiry) are accepted as no-ops. Real AWS's exact session-expiry timing is undocumented in the pinned SDK, so implementing one would mean guessing a duration rather than verifying it -- left deferred rather than fabricated."
